segments.text: You've been told it takes 21 days to build a habit. That number is a myth, and it might be why your habits keep failing.
It came from a 1960s plastic surgeon's offhand guess. Not a study. When a real lab finally measured it, the average was sixty-six days.
Some habits took up to two hundred and fifty. So if you quit on day 22 because it didn't feel automatic, you barely started.
Habits take longer than the pep talk promised. Expect two months, not three weeks, and you'll actually make it.
